cohort: Thirty postpartum healthy women aged 25 to 41 (average 34.6 years) who continued breastfeeding and suffered from VVA related symptoms were included.
finding: Application of fractional CO2 vaginal laser for postpartum vulvovaginal atrophy effectively improved both objective (VHI score) and subjective (VVA symptoms like dryness and dyspareunia) measures, with significant changes detected after the first and second treatments respectively.
followup_time: Approximately 5.3 months postpartum (initial treatment at 3.3 months postpartum, followed by 3 treatments at 4-week intervals, with assessments after each).
